integrity: Unbounded claims are supported by a written symbolic proof, not inferred from finite enumeration. Finite checker is supplementary. No independent audit or external certification claimed.
object: Binary fixed point of 0 to 0^(b-1)1 and 1 to 0^b, for each integer b>=2.
scientific_limitations: The base-two maximal-palindrome length set is earlier work; the present asserted contribution is all-base recursive words, positions, and densities. Other automatic families and prefix palindrome factorization are outside scope. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
source_date_basis: First publicly posted version of motivating work arXiv:2009.02934, 2020-09-07. The earlier 2015 base-two comparison is supporting literature, not the guiding source.
theorem_scope: All nonempty language-maximal ordinary palindromic factors, their recursive words, exact starts, and natural densities, for all b>=2 and k>=0.
title: Maximal-palindrome recursion and occurrence densities in \(b\)-adic period-doubling words
